optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: User Research Operations Specialist, E-commerce Fulfilment Software

professionalSummary.text: Owns research operations end-to-end for e-commerce fulfilment software, including participant panel management, incentive budget approval, and compliance with consent records.
professionalSummary.witness: Owned research operations for the fulfilment product for two and a half years, holding the research incentive budget and approving participant incentives myself as the budget holder recorded in the finance system. Responsibilities included research operations ownership, the incentive budget, the participant panel and the monthly operations review over about two and a half years.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed participant panel of merchant operations staff and warehouse users, maintaining screening and consent records in research tool and refreshing panel quarterly.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the participant panel of merchant operations staff and warehouse users, maintaining the panel, screening and consent records in the research tool and refreshing the panel every quarter.

experienceHighlights.text: Led monthly research operations reviews with design leads, recording decisions on panel priorities and incentive levels.
experienceHighlights.witness: Led the monthly research operations review with the design leads, deciding panel priorities and incentive levels and recording the decisions in the review notes.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated research sessions with merchant success and legal, clarifying ownership boundaries for merchant relationships, consent templates, scheduling, incentives, and panel records.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated research sessions with merchant success and legal, recording that merchant success owned the merchant relationship and legal owned the consent template while I owned scheduling, incentives and panel records.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Documented research operations processes with verification trail including finance system budget records, incentive approval logs, and monthly review notes.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the finance system's budget-holder record for the research incentive budget, the incentive approval log under the candidate's user id and one monthly review note, with the research tool's record identifiers as a verification trail.

skills.text: Research operations management, participant panel maintenance, incentive budget approval, cross-functional coordination with merchant success and legal, and documentation of research limitations.
skills.witness: Owned research operations for the fulfilment product for two and a half years, holding the research incentive budget and approving participant incentives myself as the budget holder recorded in the finance system. Ran the participant panel of merchant operations staff and warehouse users, maintaining the panel, screening and consent records in the research tool and refreshing the panel every quarter. Led the monthly research operations review with the design leads, deciding panel priorities and incentive levels and recording the decisions in the review notes. Coordinated research sessions with merchant success and legal, recording that merchant success owned the merchant relationship and legal owned the consent template while I owned scheduling, incentives and panel records. Responsibilities included research operations ownership, the incentive budget, the participant panel and the monthly operations review over about two and a half years.
